visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a pot filled with simmering salmon miso soup, containing tofu, seaweed, and vegetables. A wooden spoon stirs the ingredients. The setting is a brightly lit kitchen with warm, cozy decor in the background. (2) A person's hand pours oil from a white bottle into a small black saucepan on an induction stove. The background shows kitchen shelving with various containers. (3) Using silver tongs, the person places three thick cubes of raw pink salmon into the hot pan. (4) The salmon cubes are flipped over, showing a seared, golden-brown crust on one side. (5) The seared salmon is removed from the pan and placed onto a small lavender-colored ceramic plate. (6) Sliced white onions are added to the remaining oil in the pan and stirred with wooden chopsticks. (7) Hot water is poured from a clear glass measuring cup into the pan with the onions. (8) A white pouch-style soup base is dropped into the water. (9) Dark liquid seasoning is measured out in a silver spoon and added to the pot. (10) Clear liquid is poured from a small glass bottle into the soup. (11) A piece of kelp is added to the simmering liquid by hand. (12) The person holds a block of white tofu in one hand and carefully slices it into cubes with a knife, letting the pieces fall directly into the soup. (13) The wooden spoon stirs the tofu into the liquid. (14) The seared salmon pieces are picked up with tongs and added back into the pot with the tofu and onions. (15) A spoonful of miso paste is held over the pot, and a small metal whisk is used to dissolve it into the soup. (16) Dried green seaweed is sprinkled into the pot. (17) The wooden spoon provides a final stir to the completed soup, showing a rich, cloudy broth with all the ingredients integrated.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 一個人隨意煮 ❤️. [Slogan]: 鮭魚味噌湯. [Slogan]: 冷冷的天，暖暖的胃 ❤️. (2) [Subtitle]: 前幾天天氣明明還很熱，今天突然就轉涼了. (3) [Subtitle]: 想到冰箱還有剩下一些鮭魚、一盒豆腐. (4) [Subtitle]: 如果只煎鮭魚，感覺好像還要其他菜，好累.... (5) [Subtitle]: 好吧，那就做成鮭魚味噌湯. (6) [Subtitle]: 鮭魚先煎一下，多一個香味. (7) [Subtitle]: 再切半顆洋蔥炒一下. (8) [Subtitle]: 加點熱水. (9) [Subtitle]: 放一包昆布柴魚高湯包. (10) [Subtitle]: 調味一下. (11) [Subtitle]: 再來點清酒 🍶. (12) [Subtitle]: 啊～想到冰箱還有蒟蒻. (13) [Subtitle]: 豆腐半塊，隨意切一下. [Subtitle]: 懶得拿砧板了.... (14) [Subtitle]: 我自己平常其實都吃得很隨意. (15) [Subtitle]: 反正家裡冰箱有什麼就隨便煮. (16) [Subtitle]: 不用擔心又吃得太鹹，還是有味精會口渴. (17) [Subtitle]: 一個小鍋子準備好，想煮什麼都很自由. (18) [Subtitle]: 也可以按照自己鹹味喜好調整. (19) [Subtitle]: 最後再放點海帶芽. (20) [Subtitle]: 稍微泡一下，簡單的鮭魚海帶芽味噌湯就完成啦！

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a simple and quick tutorial for making a comforting salmon miso soup for one person, emphasizing ease of preparation and the flexibility of using whatever is available in the fridge.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced editing and bright, warm lighting to create an inviting atmosphere. The focus on POV-style cooking without speech makes it accessible and relaxing.
